decisions.reason: ACE3 is a flagship distributed ALCMS control platform that sets the firm's core airfield lighting standard and supports long installed-base lifecycles.
The air situation display complements the firm's surveillance and A-SMGCS portfolio, so it is likely kept, though it could be folded into a broader suite.
Training programs are low-cost, recurring service offerings that support customer retention, although they may be rebranded under a general academy.
The airfield ground lighting course ties directly to the core lighting business and its installed base, making it cheap and useful to maintain.
The collaboration software fits the airport digitalization trend after COVID, but software tools carry a higher risk of being merged or renamed.
The MLAT system is a strategic surveillance product with long procurement cycles, so a recent launch is unlikely to be dropped quickly.
